author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m setting a double beveled tile to complete my mitered shower bench. It’s easy to break edges, so the installation has to be done with care. I apply thin-set to the bench and tile using a 1/2 inch u-shaped trowel. Then I use the Montolit Geco suction cup to carefully install the tile and make small adjustments. Many thanks to Montolit who sent the Geco and has supported me for close to 10 years ❤️🇮🇹
title: Tile Shower Bench Tips - #tileshower #bathroomrenovation #howto
